mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher discount rates weigh on equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to corporate earnings headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.5% annualized for two consecutive quarters, it signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 2.5% annualized for two consecutive quarters, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
